# Senior Software Engineer - AI Platform — Flybuys

Source: https://www.livehire.com/careers/flybuys/job/XDM97/L1WYNZ0O1I/senior-software-engineer-ai-platform
Retrieved from the rendered advertisement on 14 October 2026. Job XDM97. Melbourne, hybrid, full time. Published 12 October 2026; closes 12 November 2026.

## Your Role

As the Senior AI Platform Engineer, you turn agreed process opportunities into secure, reliable automations across Flybuys business units. You work with business owners to understand the process before choosing deterministic workflow logic or bounded AI, then connect systems, interpret information and execute controlled actions. Document processing, classification, triage, approvals, reconciliation and exception handling are illustrative workloads. Conversational entry points can help where useful, but building chatbots for large-scale web-facing products is not your primary purpose.

You independently deliver and operate complex, agreed components and workflows within established architecture, security and responsible AI guardrails. You improve local patterns, contribute reusable capability and mentor through reviews and pairing.

## Key responsibilities

- Map processes, systems, data, rules, approval points and exceptions with business owners. Select deterministic steps or bounded AI according to the problem and risk.
- Agree baselines, acceptance criteria and handoffs with delivery partners, and measure adoption, cycle time, manual effort, quality and cost.
- Deliver agreed orchestration services, connectors and reusable components through APIs, events and controlled tool calls.
- Build stateful workflows with validated inputs, retries, idempotency and recovery from partial failure, with clear manual handoffs when confidence, permissions or availability are insufficient.
- Test model outputs and complete workflow/action behaviour, including unsafe inputs and approval enforcement.
- Apply least privilege, secure secrets, data minimisation and auditability; treat retrieved content as untrusted and preserve human validation for consequential actions.
- Release with code review, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and regression checks. Monitor failures, latency, consumption and cost; maintain support runbooks and resolve root causes.
- Improve local patterns and contribute tested implementation evidence to shared platform guidance. Review designs with Principal, Lead and architecture/security partners.
- Mentor through pairing, constructive code review and knowledge sharing, and document capabilities, limitations and operating procedures for safe adoption.

## Your Experience

- Production software engineering and multi-system enterprise integration depth, including programming, APIs, events and data handling. Chat-only or prompt-demonstration experience is insufficient.
- Process discovery with business owners: mapping rules, controls and exceptions; agreeing acceptance criteria; enabling adoption; and measuring cycle time, manual effort, quality or cost.
- Practical AI-enabled orchestration with actionable tool/API calls, bounded permissions and human approvals, with sound judgement about deterministic automation versus probabilistic AI and safe manual handoff.
- Testing and evaluation of model behaviour and workflow/action correctness, including argument validation, approval enforcement, unsafe inputs, duplicate events and regression risk.
- Production delivery and operation using CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, secure identity and secrets, observability and runbooks; resilient state, retries, idempotency, recovery and cost management.
- Clear collaboration with technical and non-technical partners, constructive reviews and mentoring, with the ability to explain limitations and trade-offs.
- Strong Azure AI experience is preferred. Relevant examples include Azure AI/Azure OpenAI, search and document processing, Functions/Logic Apps, identity and secrets, API/event integration, and Microsoft 365/Graph/Power Automate. Expertise in every named product is not required.

## About the Role
We're growing our Data & Analytics capability and are looking for multiple Data Engineers to join our team.
Working closely with our Data Leaders and broader data team, you'll help design, build and support Kinetic's enterprise data platforms and warehousing solutions. This is a hands-on role where you'll work with large and complex datasets, develop scalable data pipelines, and help enable trusted data across the business.
This opportunity suits a Data Engineer at the beginning of their career, with some experience in modern cloud data environments who enjoys solving problems, improving data quality, and delivering reliable data solutions that support business decision-making.

## What You'll Be Doing
- Supporting the ongoing development and operation of Kinetic's enterprise data platforms.
- Designing, building and maintaining scalable data pipelines.
- Developing and supporting data warehousing solutions within Microsoft Azure.
- Managing data ingestion, transformation and integration processes.
- Supporting platform administration, performance monitoring and troubleshooting activities.
- Working with large and complex datasets to deliver high-quality data solutions.
- Contributing to technical documentation, data models and data flow design.
- Collaborating with Data Engineers, developers and business stakeholders across the organisation.

## What You Bring
- Experience building ELT/ETL pipelines and working with SQL.
- Understanding of data warehousing and database management principles.
- Experience with Azure technologies such as Data Factory and/or Synapse Analytics.
- Proficiency in SQL, Python or other data engineering tools and languages.
- Experience working with APIs and system integrations.
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively within a team environment.

## Highly Regarded
- Experience working with large-scale enterprise data environments.
- Exposure to Azure data platforms and cloud-based data solutions.
- Experience with GitHub, Azure DevOps or code versioning practices.
- Experience supporting analytics, reporting or visualisation teams.

# AI Data Engineer — Compare the Market
Source: https://www.livehire.com/careers/comparethemarket/job/T48E6/1RJC8UD0H5/ai-data-engineer
Retrieved from the rendered LiveHire advertisement on 14 October 2026. Job T48E6. Brisbane QLD. Full time. Published 13 October 2026. Role/requirements copy; employer marketing and eligibility checks omitted from evidence classification.

## What You'll Be Doing
The AI Data Engineer designs and delivers AI-enabled data platform capabilities that position CTM at the forefront of data, automation, and AI. Combining data, AI, and platform engineering disciplines, the role builds scalable, secure, and production-ready foundations that accelerate the adoption of agentic AI across the organisation.
Working across CTM's cloud-based data platform, the role develops AI-driven infrastructure, intelligent automation, and reusable AI services that support advanced analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and agent-based technologies. The AI Data Engineer ensures CTM's data ecosystem is AI-ready through modern architectures, automation frameworks, vector-based retrieval, and intelligent agent capabilities.
Partnering with data teams, architects, and business stakeholders, the role identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, automate processes, enhance decision-making, and accelerate the delivery of data products and insights. The role also contributes to engineering standards, AI governance, and platform capabilities that enable the secure, responsible, and sustainable adoption of AI across the enterprise.
- Design, develop, and implement AI-driven data solutions and agent-based products on the EDW that support model learning, generative AI, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics for better data discovery
- Develop, deploy, and operationalise foundational models, LLMs, RAG, semantic search, vector retrieval, embeddings, and enterprise knowledge management capabilities
- Design and implement intelligent automation and agentic AI solutions leveraging AI agents, orchestration frameworks, multi-agent architectures, workflow automation, and reusable AI services and APIs
- Establish and champion AI engineering best practices including MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, query observability, experiment tracking, benchmarking and token usage management
- Drive AI innovation, platform optimisation, and governance by evaluating emerging technologies, improving model performance and cost efficiency, and ensuring compliance with security, privacy, data governance, and Responsible AI standards

## What Sets You Apart
Minimum a bachelor's degree qualified in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science or a relevant discipline.
- 4+ years' experience in Gen AI Engineering, Data Engineering, Integration Engineering, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related disciplines, delivering enterprise-scale solutions from concept through to commerical deployment
- Proven experience in designing, developing, deploying, monitoring, and optimising raw models, including model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, versioning, experiment tracking, observability, drift detection, and token usage management
- Strong expertise in Generative or Agentic AI engineering patterns, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, vector search, embeddings, prompt engineering, context management, AI agents, tool calling, and multi-agent architectures
- Experience building agent powered applications and intelligent automation solutions, including enterprise copilots, chatbots, knowledge assistants, research agents, workflow automation, and decision-support capabilities
- Hands-on experience with modern frameworks and platforms, including PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Microsoft Copilot Studio
- Experience with AI-driven data solutions on EDPs, knowledge repositories, feature stores, vector databases, and data products using cloud-native Data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric, Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, AWS, Azure, or GCP
- Experience operationalising agent solutions using MLOps and LLMOps practices, including MLflow, Databricks ML, SageMaker, Bedrock, AI Foundry, Vertex AI, containerisation, and deployment automation
- Strong understanding of AI governance, security, and Responsible AI principles, including data privacy, data sovereignty, model governance, access controls, metadata management, lineage, compliance, and optimisation of model performance, scalability, latency, and cost efficiency
